facts.fact: CITE reports Deputy Chief Justice Gwaunza saying the IECMS has been in use since May 2022 in the Constitutional, Supreme and High Courts' divisions and the Labour and Administrative Courts, with 23,623 users by January 2024.
From the first paperless court's commissioning on 6 May 2022, filing of court documents and processes became electronic, and the speech says filing improved after November 2023.

ZWE.note: No tax or fee payment stated.
